title: Voice of the Customers: Local Trust Culture and Consumer Complaints to the CFPB
sources_checked: Accepted prepared input work/bankfees.dta (SHA-256 83bdab9b28a1e0490cdf00451d10d452aa52d705d1c5e70c3129512cf1070648; byte-identical to the predecessor package input). A bounded aggregate read of numeric year, rssd9001, and post found 48,445 bank-year rows, years 2002–2006 and 2011–2015 only, no missing years, and no duplicate rssd9001-year keys.

Accepted author analysis work/JAR_T7&8.do and predecessor native report output/executions/packages/jar-ed92a9a6b996/report.json; the report records the earlier eight-model Stata stage as succeeded, but its comparison is no_reference.

Predecessor author package ReadMe.docx, JAR_T7&8.do, input data.do, and generation_001/work_item.json inventory. The README describes the longer bank-year data window; the package inventory includes bankfees.dta but no separate producer, and input data.do contains no bankfees builder.

Paper source record papers/parsed/verified/author_samples/jar-ed92a9a6b996.json: page 19 §3.5 names quarterly FDIC Call Reports, aggregation to annual data, and fields RIAD4080, RIADB492, and RIADB497; pages 35–36 and 38–39 describe Tables 7 and 8 longer-period samples.

Local data catalogs checked by exact source and field identifiers: the predecessor frozen catalog historical artifact catalog.json, repository catalog output/feasibility_reproduction/resources/catalog.json, and PROC CONTENTS source catalog. No entries matched FDIC, Call Reports, FFIEC, RIAD4080, RIADB492, RIADB497, bankfees, or nonintincpct fields; unindexed sources were not surveyed.
changes: The applicable observation clock is calendar year. The accepted longer window is 2002–2006 and 2011–2015, retaining the 2007–2010 exclusion; the requested five-year endpoint is 2020, which would add 2016–2020. Verified prepared-input support ends in 2015.

No scientific code, estimator, or data were changed. No author plan or native launch was prepared because the current exact source and an existing bankfees preparation route for 2016–2020 could not be verified.
The task sample record state_complaints describes the Table 3 state cross-section and does not map to this assigned bank-year Tables 7–8 branch; sample_ids is therefore empty.
limitations: The disposition is blocked at preflight. The packaged bankfees.dta is verified only through 2015 and contains no 2016–2020 observations. The paper identifies FDIC Call Reports as the underlying source, but the accepted package has no bankfees builder and the checked local catalogs do not identify the source inputs or their usable date coverage. The prepared-file boundary is not evidence of raw Call Report coverage.

No extended fit was run, so no estimation-sample counts, added observations, last contributing year, native log, or extended coefficient are available. The predecessor report records successful execution of the original eight regressions but no saved numerical comparison reference; a like-for-like extended comparison is unavailable.

The accepted code uses an HHI split cutoff of 0.4430112, while manuscript page 38 describes the more-competition threshold as HHI < 0.445. The accepted code value is documented and left untouched; this difference was not resolved because no extended run was feasible.

The task supplies only sample_id state_complaints for Table 3A, whereas the accepted worked scope is the distinct bank-year Tables 7–8 analysis. The branch is mapped from the accepted program and README, not assigned the unrelated state sample.
